literal_gloss: I-read the Acts of-the Fifth Council, in which the so-called three chapters were-treated — both the-things concerning Origen, and he-himself was-anathematized and his writings, and the-things concerning Diodorus of-Tarsus and Theodore of-Mopsuestia, and they likewise were-anathematized. And Theodoret's twelve chapters written against those of Cyril were-anathematized. And there-came-to-be also before this some sessions concerning both Zooras and Anthimus of-Trebizond who-slipped-into the throne of-Constantinople, and some others, which were-included with this.
lemmas: ΠΡΑΚΤΙΚΑ ΤΗΣ ΠΕΜΠΤΗΣ ΣΥΝΟΔΟΥ (Acts of the Fifth Council)
